source.article_title: Honeybees disrupt the structure and functionality of plant-pollinator networks

source_reported_structure.published_network_representation: weighted quantitative adjacency matrices using average visit rate

next_gate: Retain as a source-structure candidate until the 2026-09-27 hard stop. Admit only if lawful public or user-supplied machine-readable census/network bytes appear that preserve the six source-native period-year bins, partner identities, quantitative interactions and effort. Do not transcribe the supplementary PDF into pseudo-raw data and do not infer D1 or phi from published network summaries.
claim_boundary: The article establishes that suitable raw individual-census data existed and that six weighted period-year networks were analysed, but the frozen natural-regime route requires public machine-readable reconstructible interaction data. Absence of a recovered public machine-readable file is an availability state, not evidence about biological breadth or synchrony.
